svg.aria-label: 5F2-A · EYELET BOARD LAYOUT — redrawn board layout diagram, layout-sheet drafting style
svg.text: Redrawn from Fender 'Princeton' Model 5F2-A layout drawing (K-EG), page 1 (draft circuit — no 5F2-A voltage chart; operating point checked against the DC-identical 5F1 Champ) — not a trace
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
